record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: For c ≥ 3, determine whether the properly coloured Hamilton cycle problem on c-edge-coloured complete graphs is polynomial-time solvable.

evidence.quote: We conjecture that the PC Hamilton cycle problem for c-edge-coloured complete graphs when c ≥ 3 is polynomial-time solvable.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $c \geq 3$ be an integer. A $c$-edge-coloured complete graph is a complete graph $K_n$ together with a map from its edge set to a set of $c$ colours. A cycle (respectively path) in such a graph is called properly coloured if every two consecutive edges along the cycle (respectively path) receive distinct colours. A properly coloured Hamilton cycle is a properly coloured cycle that visits every vertex exactly once.

The properly coloured Hamilton cycle problem on $c$-edge-coloured complete graphs is the following decision problem: given a $c$-edge-coloured complete graph $K_n$, decide whether it contains a properly coloured Hamilton cycle.

Determine whether, for every fixed $c \geq 3$, this decision problem can be solved in time polynomial in $n$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surfaced related structural results (e.g., Bollobás–Erdős type conditions, results by Alon–Gutin, and a polynomial-time algorithm for the 2-edge-coloured case via alternating cycles in bipartite digraphs), but no result establishing or refuting polynomial-time solvability of the properly coloured Hamilton cycle problem on c-edge-coloured complete graphs for general fixed c ≥ 3. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Properly coloured Hamiltonian cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies sufficient conditions for properly coloured Hamilton cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work focuses on structural/sufficient conditions rather than settling polynomial-time complexity for c ≥ 3.

status_evidence.title: Properly colored Hamilton cycles in edge colored complete graphs (Alon, Gutin)
status_evidence.snippet: Existence results for properly coloured Hamilton cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Existence results are known but the algorithmic complexity question for c ≥ 3 is not resolved in this line of work.
